name: Lending Money
overview: Scripture teaches that lending money should be an act of mercy and discretion, especially towards those who are poor or in need. Believers are instructed not to charge usury or exploit the vulnerable, emphasizing kindness and generosity rather than profit (Exodus 22:25; Deuteronomy 23:19). Lending is portrayed as a way to strengthen and support others, reflecting a righteous character that shows favor and mercy (Leviticus 25:35; Psalms 37:21; Psalms 112:5). Those who lend without seeking unjust gain are promised stability and blessing (Psalms 15:5).
